areas.label: for the Graduate Minor in Russian, East European, and Eurasian Studies

courses.title: Collection Development (Section C: REEES Bibliog Research Methods)

groups.label: Electives (4 hours at the 500 level) At least 8 graduate hours that relate to Russia, Eastern Europe, or Eurasia chosen from the list of approved courses maintained by REEEC and taken outside the student's enrolling department.
groups.note: Language Requirement: A minimum of two years or equivalent college-level study of a language of the area. For professional work in the region or scholarly research on area topics at least three years of relevant language study are recommended. Students must also submit a research paper primarily on the region.

facts.text: The page states a total of 12 credit hours.
